Shireen Abu Akleh

Abu Akleh was one of the most influential journalists documenting the Israeli-Palestinian conflict. Her death intensified global scrutiny of journalist protection and accountability in the conflict.

2022 · Political leader · Assassination

Shinzo Abe

Abe remained Japan's most influential conservative politician and shaped defence policy, constitutional revision, regional alliances, and party power. The killing exposed deep ties between Japanese politics and the Unification Church and reshaped security policy.

2022 · Journalist · Police killing

Arshad Sharif

Sharif had reported on corruption, the military, political power, and regime change and had fled Pakistan after threats and criminal cases. His death became a major test of transnational repression and journalist safety.
